budget_gate.billing_surface: OpenAI API, separate from a ChatGPT subscription

candidate_policy.initial_pilot: choose one existing hash-pinned flawed baseline before randomization
candidate_policy.scorer: reuse the frozen deterministic defect-area scorer without changing its primary scores
candidate_policy.series: a full series must freeze at least two independent candidates before its first call

arms.shape: one direct Responses API critic call

arms.input: a root turn delegates exactly one critic task with fork_turns none and an explicit compact capsule
arms.shape: one root execution plus one isolated subagent execution

arms.input: a root turn receives the full visible bundle and delegates exactly one critic task with inherited turns
arms.shape: one root execution plus one context-inheriting subagent execution

comparison.model_rule: freeze one exact model identifier supported by every arm and do not compare these API arms directly with the earlier CLI series
comparison.question: At equal deterministic critic quality, does native agent context propagation reduce total reported input or completion time relative to a portable TORC capsule?
comparison.temperature_and_effort_rule: freeze identical supported settings across arms

continue_after_pilot_only_if: all arms produce a scoreable critic result
the apparatus exposes root and subagent usage separately
the native arms use exactly one subagent and no unplanned tools
no candidate, prompt, scorer, or model drift is detected
native_win_requires: no lower deterministic defect recall than portable_direct
at least 15 percent lower median total uncached input than portable_direct
no more than 20 percent higher median completion time
zero unsupported findings introduced by native transport
stop_after_pilot_if: a native arm cannot expose complete root and subagent usage
a native arm has lower deterministic defect recall
a native arm has no plausible path to the 15 percent total-input threshold
the provider launches extra agents or retries that cannot be bounded and counted

count_in_total_usage: root input, cached input, reasoning output, and output
every subagent input, cached input, reasoning output, and output
record: exact request configuration with credentials removed
candidate, capsule, prompt, and scorer hashes
root and subagent turn identifiers and usage
opaque artifact type, byte length, and SHA-256 digest only
raw critic result and deterministic score

limitations: Native encrypted items are provider artifacts, not a provider-neutral TORC handoff format.
API model and system context may differ from Codex CLI, so Series 002 is motivation rather than a matched control.
A ChatGPT Plus subscription does not authorize or fund Responses API calls.
Total native-agent cost can exceed a direct call even when the child context is smaller.
name: Native context propagation follow-up
